conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.effect: Cannot see; attacks against the creature have Advantage, and its attacks have Disadvantage. Automatically fails sight-dependent checks.

conditions.name: Charmed
conditions.effect: Cannot attack or directly harm the charmer and the charmer has Advantage on social checks against it. Does not force evidence revelation or accusation choices.

conditions.name: Deafened
conditions.effect: Cannot hear and automatically fails hearing-dependent checks.

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.effect: Has Disadvantage on ability checks and attacks while the fear source is visible and cannot willingly move closer to it.

conditions.name: Grappled
conditions.effect: Speed becomes 0. Ends if the grappler is incapacitated or the creature escapes.

conditions.name: Incapacitated
conditions.effect: Cannot take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions and loses Concentration.

conditions.name: Invisible
conditions.effect: Cannot be seen without a special sense; attacks against it have Disadvantage and its attacks have Advantage when location is known.

conditions.name: Paralyzed
conditions.effect: Incapacitated, speed 0, automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves; attacks from within 5 feet that hit are critical hits.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.effect: Has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.effect: Crawls at extra movement cost; attacks within 5 feet have Advantage, farther attacks have Disadvantage; its attacks have Disadvantage.

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.effect: Speed 0; attacks against it have Advantage, its attacks have Disadvantage, and it has Disadvantage on Dexterity saves.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.effect: Incapacitated, speed 0, automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves, and attacks against it have Advantage.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.effect: Incapacitated and Prone, drops held items, automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves, and close hits are critical hits.

conditions.name: Burning
conditions.effect: Killer condition: takes listed fire damage at the start of each turn until an Action, water, smothering, or another stated counterplay ends it.

conditions.name: Corroding
conditions.effect: Killer condition: takes listed acid damage at the start of each turn until cleaned, neutralized, scraped away, or the source ends.

conditions.name: Cursed
conditions.effect: Killer marker for a named persistent magical penalty; each curse states its removal method.

conditions.name: Downed
conditions.effect: At 0 HP, Unconscious and making death saves unless stabilized. Three successes stabilize; three failures kill. Damage can cause failures.

conditions.name: Eliminated
conditions.effect: A dead hero outside the two-round restoration window. The player becomes a spectator unless Gunnus’s Work Separately zombie rule or a lobby variant applies.

healing_rules: Healing cannot raise HP above maximum.
A creature at 0 HP that receives healing regains consciousness unless a rule says otherwise.
Temporary HP does not stack; keep the higher amount.
A stabilized hero remains at 0 HP and stops making death saves.
killer_elimination_rule: A dead hero can be restored within two rounds. After that, the hero is Eliminated for the current mystery unless a named Killer rule applies.

resting.short_rest: A defended pause that restores selected class resources and allows limited healing.
resting.long_rest: A risky multi-turn rest that refreshes limited powers but can advance the storm, spawn patrols, or allow rivals to move.
